asr.full_text: Coinbase has recently added the ability to deposit SGD via bank transfer. So, in this video, I will be giving you a step by step guide on how to use Coinbase. I will show you how to fund your account, buy your crypto, sell it and withdraw the money back out. Or if you want to hoarder your crypto, I will also show you how to transfer the crypto out to an external wallet. Then, finally, I will also share 1 bonus tip at the end. But first here are 2 important warnings, 1 MAS has already said that crypto is super dangerous for retail investors so if you are planning to touch crypto, just know that there is a good chance that you will lose money ya? Second, as we have learnt from FTX and many other crypto platform, there's no platform that is 100% safe. So, never ever keep your assets in crypto platform, only use it to buy or immediately transfer the crypto out. Okay with that, let's jump right in. Okay here's the coinbase website. First thing first, click on the profile button on the top right, click dark mode to change it to dark mode.. ah.. that's better! As they say, once you go black, you never go back. I will now show you how to duplicate SGD into coin base. To do that, go to my assets click add cache.. here.. you will geet the bank account details that you have to transfer to. I m using DBS so i will just show you how to do this in dbs. At the top, mouse over transfer, click to other bank account. Fast. For recipient's name, head over to coinbase, copy the recipient's name, head back, paste it in. Recipient's Bank, head over to Coinbase, it says Standard Chartered Bank. So just head back, look for standard chartered bank. So, just go back, look for Standard Chartered Bank. Next, you will need to enter the recipient's account number. So, just go to Coinbase, copy the bank account number, head back and paste it in. After that, just select the account that you want to transfer from and the transfer amount. If it's your first time, I suggest trying with small amount first, like around $10. For purpose of transfer, since there's no YOLO option here, I will just choose Investments and Securities. Finally, for comments for recipient head over to coinbase. Copy the payment reference, head back and paste it in. Then click next, check everything is correct then submit. The funds should arrive almost instantly. Though, it's not showing up on my coinbase because a weird bug is going on where the changes are not reflected immediately. So, a quick phase is to refresh the entire website and boom! That $100 is now showing up in my account. Next, let me show you how to buy cryptos. Go to Trade at the top. There are actually two options, Simple and Advanced. For simple, you will be directly buying the crypto with SGD but the fees will be higher. I wasn't able to find the pricing list for simple trades but when I was testing this out, I found coinbase was charging a 3% fee if you buy bitcoin via the Sgd wallet and a 4% fee if you are buying with a credit card. So, that's super duper expensive ah? 3. As for advance, you'll be able to convert between different cryptos, have access to a lot more advance stuff like charts, order books, and different order types. The fees are a lot cheaper, starting at 0.4% to0.62% and the more you trade, the cheaper it gets. But the downside, there's no SGD trading pair here. So, if you are planning to finalize SGD, you will have to first use the simple mode to buy the crypto that you want, then go to advance mode to trade other cryptos. For this tutorial, i'll just show you how to buy in the simple mode. First, look for the crypto that you want. Then click on BYE. Enter the amount that you want to buy. Make sure you're paying with your SGD wallet. Click preview buy. Check everything is correct- then click Buy Now. And that's it, you have successfully bought your cryptos! If you want to see your past transactions, you can just click on the cryptocurrency and go to primary balance and you will see all your transactions for the cryptocurrency Next selling is also super easy, go to the trade tab at the right hand side change it to sell, make sure that you have selected the correct cryptocurrency and have chosen SGD wallet ,then enter the amount that you want to sell. Click Preview Sell. Check everything is alright then click Sell now to sell your crypto. So that's how to sell your crypto. Next, if you want to redraw the money back to your bank account. Here's how to do it. Go to My Assets. Click Cash Out. Then on the right-hand side, choose the amount that you want to cash out then click continue. If you've previously funded with FastTransfer, coinbase will already have your bank account info Click continue. Click cash out now and you'll receive the money almost instantly. But of course most of you guys are planning to hoard crypto for the long term that's alright, but don't keep your crypto in Coinbase, because as Coinbase had already warn, customers could lose their crypto if coinbase goes bankrupt, so that's super dangerous. That's why you will need to always transfer the cryptos out to an external wallet. If you don't want buy a wallet, you can either transfer it to Metamask or Trust wallets — those are called hot wallets, where it's connected to the internet. So there's a risk that the hackers can steal your cryptos from there. A better choice would be to transfer it to a cold wallet like Ledger or Trezor, both of which cost around $120-$250 to buy. But they're definitely a lot safer than keeping it online. I've links to both ledger and trezor, you can check them out down below if you want. But for this tutorial, I'll just show you how to transfer to a ledger. At the top, click send and receive. Choose the crypto that you want to send and enter the amount. If it's your first time sending, try sending a small amount first to test it out. That way you'll only lose a little amount if something goes wrong. Next, you'll need to enter the destination address. So let's head over to Ledger Live to look for the wallet address. At Ledger live, click on receive, enter the crypto that you want to receive, click continue. Do all the verification on the ledger device and you will get your address. Copy it, head back to coinbase, paste it in, click continue and you will need to enter the recipient details as required by regulations. Click pre-send, check everything is correct, then click send now. Enter the 7 digit code and you are done. If you have done it correctly, the crypto should arrive in just 30 minutes. If you want to check the transaction status, go to MyAssets. Click on the crypto, Click primary balance And you will be able to see the status here. So that was a super quick tutorial on how to use Coinbase. Finally, since you're staying all the way to the end, here's a bonus tip for you! Coinbase has a learning rewards program, where if you go through all the lessons and answer the quiz, you'll be able to earn up to $10 in free cryptos so that's nice! But if you want to cheat a bit, I've found a website which has all the quiz answers, which I'll link down below so you can just refer to that, or if you have any other questions, you can also join my fast growing Telegram group to ask me and the members any questions that you may have. Anyway, that's all for this video, hopefully, you find it useful. Like, share, and subscribe as I will be posting new videos every Monday, Wednesday and friday.
